title: How to Transfer Ownership of a Discord Server
body:
You can seamlessly transfer ownership to another server member when your community outgrows your availability, you need temporary management, or you're ready to pass the torch to dedicated leadership.

Transferring server ownership gives you the flexibility to ensure your server continues thriving, whether it's a permanent transition or temporary arrangement.

What this article covers:

  • Desktop/Browser App Instructions
  • Mobile App Instructions

Desktop/Browser App Instructions

1. Select the server you want to transfer ownership to, then press the Members tab.

Server Settings option

2. Right-click on the server member you want to transfer the server to and press Transfer Ownership.

Transfer Ownership option

3. After pressing Transfer Ownership, you’ll see a confirmation window. Select the toggle to confirm and acknowledge the transfer, then select Transfer Ownership. If you have MFA enabled on your account, you’ll be requested to enter your MFA code.

Transfer Ownership confirmation box

4. Now your server will have a new owner! After completing the transfer, you will still be a member of the server. The access you retain will depend on the permissions tied to your new role.

Mobile App Instructions

1. Select the server you want to transfer, then press Server Settings.

Settings button for a server

2. Press on Members to access your server’s members list.

Members button to access your server’s members list

3. Tap the server member you want to transfer the server to, then select Transfer Ownership.

Transfer Ownership confirmation

4. You should then see a confirmation screen. After confirming your acknowledgement, press Transfer. If you have MFA enabled on your account, you’ll be requested to enter your MFA code.

Transfer button confirmation

5. Now your server will have a new owner! After completing the transfer, you will still be a member of the server. The access you retain will depend on the permissions tied to your new role.

Important: Once a server has been transferred, Discord’s Support team is not able to transfer it back.
